note: The colour-scheme allowlist (issue 050, retargeted by issue 060). A scheme is one block of --vd-* tokens in website/vd-tokens.css, selected by data-vd-theme on <html>. Selection may only ever name a key from this file — never a URL, never a query parameter (the issue-041 rule: nothing outside the repo decides what the page loads). CI checks every scheme declares exactly the tokens Signal declares, so a half-finished scheme fails the build instead of shipping with holes. Nothing at runtime reads this file yet: no scheme picker is exposed to users, and until one is, Signal is what everybody gets.

signal.label: Signal
signal.description: Light, green. The default and the only scheme any visitor currently sees. The accent moved off Meta's #25d366 to #0E9E72 — same family, cooler, dark enough to hold 4.5:1 as text on white.

night.label: Night
night.description: Dark, green. DRAFT because the --wa-* bridge layer conflates a card surface with text-on-dark; a component must be ported to --vd-* before it can claim to support a dark scheme.

paper.label: Paper
paper.description: Warm off-white, terracotta. Same caveat as Night for any --wa-* component, though it is a light scheme so the bridge mostly holds.

blueprint.label: Blueprint
blueprint.description: White, electric blue, hard greys. Light, so the bridge holds.

ember.label: Ember
ember.description: Dark, amber. Same caveat as Night.
